newsitem.title: DUBAI: Qatar Al-Rayyan oilfield to start early November.
newsitem.headline: Qatar Al-Rayyan oilfield to start early November.

text.p: First oil output at Qatar's offshore Al-Rayyan field is expected by early November, operator Atlantic Richfield Co (ARCO) said Monday.
The 35,000 barrels per day (bpd) capacity field will tip Qatar's oil output capacity to over 500,000 barrels per day (bpd), well above its current OPEC quota of 378,000 bpd.
"We are going to be starting in early November," said Paul Fronterhouse, vice president and resident manager of ARCO in Qatar.
Al-Rayyan heavy crude will be marketed out of a 900,000-barrel capacity storage tanker separately from Qatar's main Marine and Land export grades.
A cargo of Al-Rayyan was traded into Japan earlier this month at a price of Arab Heavy less 50 cents.
The field's platform is now at station, wells are being hooked up and platform lines are being tested, Fronterhouse said.

Field operator ARCO Qatar Inc has a 27.5 percent stake in a consortium with Gulf Stream Resources Canada Ltd (27.5 percent), British Gas Plc (25 percent and German firms Wintershall (15 percent) and Preussag Energies (five percent).
